spec.description: Whether Renovate runs on schedule and how each run ended, with what needs your attention and the run history. The attention tiles need the rules from alerts/promql.yaml loaded.

spec.title: Runs
spec.description: Shows while the RenovateRunFailed alert fires: the latest full or scoped run failed, and a tolerated failure does not count. The Last run of each scope table names the scope and how the run ended, and the container log says why. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Full runs
spec.description: Shows while the RenovateNoRecentRun alert fires: no complete full run has finished by the run deadline, or in 14 hours while there is no deadline. Runs may be failing or tolerated, or the schedule has stopped. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Scrape
spec.description: Shows while the RenovateDown alert fires: no scrape of the metrics page has succeeded for 5 minutes. A target that is gone has no instance, so the tile also shows for an alert without one. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.expr: 0 * max((ALERTS{alertname="RenovateDown", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"} or ALERTS{alertname="RenovateDown", alertstate="firing", instance=""}))

spec.title: Last full run
spec.description: Whether the latest run over every repository passed. A failure that GitHub or the platform caused counts as passed for its first 2 hours, and the Failing since tile shows it. No value means no full run has ended since the start, or the scheduler was not scraped.

spec.title: Last complete full run
spec.description: When the latest full run that ended with no error finished, kept across a restart. Failed and tolerated runs do not move it. No value means none is on record, or the scheduler was not scraped.

spec.title: Next full run due
spec.description: The time by which the next complete full run is due. That is the last one plus two RUN_INTERVAL periods and one RUN_TIMEOUT, and 2 minutes more in GitHub App mode. Past it, the Full runs tile lights up after 45 minutes. No value means RUN_INTERVAL is off, so your own scheduler sets the pace, or the scheduler was not scraped.

spec.title: Failing since
spec.description: When full runs began to end in repository errors or GitHub App token outages. These pass as warnings for 2 hours, then each run fails until a good one. No value means full runs are not failing this way.

spec.title: Last run of each scope
spec.description: One row per scope from its first run after a start: Full is a run over every repository, Scoped a run that named repositories. Each row shows how the latest run ended, Renovate's exit code, the run time and the end time. A repository error or a token outage shows in yellow. It passes as a warning for its first 2 hours, then the run counts as failed and Needs attention shows it.

defaults.noValue: No run since the start, or the scheduler was not scraped

spec.title: Runs by result
spec.description: Completed runs in each time slot, by scope and how they ended, with the total for the selected range in the legend. A run of failures shows when the trouble began and whether good runs came between.

spec.title: Run time
spec.description: How long the latest run of each scope took, over the selected range. A full run that grows toward RUN_TIMEOUT will soon time out: raise the timeout or give Renovate fewer repositories.

spec.title: Renovate Scheduler

spec.name: instance
spec.label: Scheduler
spec.description: The docker-renovate-scheduler to show, by its scrape instance. Each container runs its own schedule.

spec.name: attention
spec.label: Attention tiles shown
spec.description: How many Needs attention tiles have data. The row shows only while one does.

spec.query: query_result(count(label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="RenovateRunFailed", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "1", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="RenovateNoRecentRun", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "2", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max((ALERTS{alertname="RenovateDown", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"} or ALERTS{alertname="RenovateDown", alertstate="firing", instance=""}))), "tile", "3", "", "")) or vector(0))

spec.definition: query_result(count(label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="RenovateRunFailed", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "1", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="RenovateNoRecentRun", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "2", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max((ALERTS{alertname="RenovateDown", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"} or ALERTS{alertname="RenovateDown", alertstate="firing", instance=""}))), "tile", "3", "", "")) or vector(0))
